3 bed / 2 bath entire-home short-term rental. The comp set prioritizes nearby properties with similar bedroom count, bath count, and guest capacity within Wilmington.

Market Read

The Wilmington STR market across 463 active listings averages a 45% occupancy rate, a $269 ADR, and $31,600 in annual revenue — all metrics that Zuma currently falls short of. Notably, Zuma's recent 90-day ADR of $281 actually exceeds the market average of $269, confirming the property can command premium rates. Closing the occupancy gap alone would bring Zuma to market parity and unlock significant revenue growth.

Performance Analytics · Market Occupancy by Month

Seasonal performance patterns

Market occupancy across the calendar year, used to time rate strategy between peak and shoulder windows.

Peak SeasonMay to Aug

Wilmington occupancy peaks during May to Aug, ranging from 46% to 59%. Premium ADR is achievable in this window; protect rate and avoid early-bird discounting that erodes peak revenue.

Shoulder SeasonSep to Apr

Occupancy softens during Sep to Apr, ranging from 33% to 45%. Strategic amenity positioning, longer-stay incentives, and gap-night pricing can lift shoulder-season occupancy meaningfully.
